name: ali_cbct
description: Automated Anatomic Landmarks Identification on CBCT scans using AI agents. Detects anatomical reference points on cone-beam CT volumes for precise dental and maxillofacial measurements and analysis.

name: ali_ios
description: Automatic Landmark Identification in Intraoral Scans (IOS). Detects dental and anatomical landmarks on 3D surface meshes from intraoral scanners for orthodontic and prosthodontic analysis.

name: amasss_cli
description: AMASSS - Anatomical Structures Segmentation from CBCT using deep learning. Automatic segmentation of maxilla, mandible, and other anatomical structures using nnUNet-based models trained on dental CBCT data.

name: areg_cbct
description: Automatic Registration of CBCT images for longitudinal studies. Registers baseline and follow-up CBCT scans using deformable or rigid registration to track anatomical changes over time.

name: areg_ios
description: Automatic Registration of Intraoral Scans using Iterative Closest Point (ICP). Registers baseline and follow-up IOS surfaces for longitudinal dental tracking and treatment outcome assessment.

name: autocrop3d
description: Automatic 3D region cropping using ROI markers. Extracts and crops regions of interest from 3D volumetric medical images (CT, MRI, CBCT) using point-based or region markers for focused analysis.

name: automatrix
description: Automatic transformation matrix application to scans and surfaces. Applies pre-computed transformation matrices (rigid, affine, or deformable) to medical images and 3D surface meshes for standardized registration.

name: batchdentalseg
description: Batch Dental Segmentation using nnUNet in 3D Slicer. Automated segmentation of dental structures (teeth, bone, soft tissue) from CBCT scans using pre-trained nnUNet deep learning models with batch processing support.

name: clic
description: CLIC - Mask-RCNN CBCT segmentation (GPU/CPU) integrated in 3D Slicer. Instance segmentation of dental and anatomical structures from CBCT using Mask R-CNN with GPU acceleration support for real-time performance.

name: docshapeaxi
description: Shape Analysis of dental surfaces using ShapeAXI. Statistical shape analysis and classification of 3D dental meshes with GradCAM visualization for interpretability and morphometric feature extraction.

name: flexreg
description: Flexible Patch-based Registration for dental surfaces. Registers 3D dental surface meshes using patch-based deformable registration with butterfly and curve patch methods for precision tooth movement tracking.

name: medx_dashboard
description: MedX Dashboard - Interactive visualization of medical data and analysis summaries. Generates HTML dashboards for visual exploration of clinical outcomes, measurements, and longitudinal study results.

name: medx_summarize
description: MedX Summarize - Automatic medical text summarization using transformers. Generates concise clinical summaries from patient notes (PDF, DOCX, TXT) using transformer-based NLP models for quick clinical review.

name: mri2cbct_approx
description: MRI to CBCT approximation and preprocessing for multimodal registration. Preprocesses MRI and CBCT scans with intensity normalization and spatial reorientation for subsequent multimodal registration and fusion.

name: mri2cbct_reg
description: MRI to CBCT image registration with intensity normalization. Registers MRI volumes to CBCT reference frames using deformable registration with automatic intensity normalization for joint imaging analysis.

name: mri2cbct_lr_crop
description: Crop MRI and CBCT volumes for left-right asymmetry analysis. Extracts left and right hemimandibular or hemimaxillary regions from registered MRI-CBCT pairs for bilaterial morphometric comparison and asymmetry assessment.

name: mri2cbct_orient_center
description: Orient and center MRI scans for standardized positioning. Automatically reorients and centers MRI volumes to a canonical anatomical frame of reference for standardized analysis and comparison across subjects.

name: mri2cbct_resample
description: Resample MRI and CBCT to uniform spacing. Interpolates medical images to isotropic or anisotropic target resolution for standardized processing and compatibility with subsequent deep learning or analysis pipelines.

name: mri2cbct_tmj_crop
description: Automatic Temporomandibular Joint (TMJ) region segmentation and cropping. Automatically segments and extracts TMJ regions from MRI and CBCT scans using trained nnUNet models for focused TMJ analysis and disorder assessment.

name: pre_aso_cbct
description: Preprocessing for Automatic Segmentation Orientation - CBCT. Preprocesses CBCT scans with standardized resampling, orientation correction, and field-of-view adjustment for subsequent automated segmentation pipelines.

name: pre_aso_ios
description: Preprocessing for Automatic Segmentation Orientation - IOS. Orients and preprocesses intraoral scan surfaces for standardized coordinate frames and tooth-specific segmentation and analysis.

name: semi_aso_cbct
description: Semi-Automatic Segmentation Orientation for CBCT using landmarks. Combines manually-placed anatomical landmarks with ICP-based registration to orient and standardize CBCT scans for consistent segmentation.

name: semi_aso_ios
description: Semi-Automatic Segmentation Orientation for IOS using landmarks. Uses manually-placed anatomical landmarks on dental surfaces with ICP registration to establish canonical tooth and jaw coordinate frames for analysis.
